def count_rotation(arr):
    """
    Count the number of rotations in a sorted array that has been rotated.
    Returns the first index i where arr[i] < arr[i-1], else 0.
    """
    for i in range(1, len(arr)):
        if arr[i] < arr[i - 1]:
            return i
    return 0


assert count_rotation([3, 2, 1]) == 1
